cases.question: What changed in Atlas Runner's supported concurrency, and what is current now?
cases.initial_question: What concurrency does Atlas Runner support?

initial_sources.title: Atlas Runner 1.0 release notes
initial_sources.text: Atlas Runner 1.0 supports up to 8 concurrent jobs.

followup_sources.title: Atlas Runner 1.1 release notes
followup_sources.text: Atlas Runner 1.1 raises the supported limit from 8 to 16 concurrent jobs.

change_events: The supported limit increased from 8 to 16.

cases.question: Did Northstar remove policy checks, or were they renamed?
cases.initial_question: How are policy checks configured in Northstar?

initial_sources.title: Northstar 3 guide
initial_sources.text: Northstar 3 calls pre-deployment controls policy checks.

followup_sources.title: Northstar 4 migration guide
followup_sources.text: Northstar 4 renames policy checks to release guards; their purpose is unchanged.

change_events: Policy checks were renamed release guards.
current_truths: Northstar 4 uses the term release guards.
historical_truths: Northstar 3 used the term policy checks.

cases.question: Is there independent confirmation that BirchDB passed the audit?
cases.initial_question: What does BirchDB say about its audit status?

initial_sources.title: BirchDB press release
initial_sources.text: BirchDB states that it passed the Cedar security audit.

followup_sources.title: Industry Wire
followup_sources.text: Syndicated verbatim from BirchDB: BirchDB states that it passed the Cedar security audit.

current_truths: BirchDB claims it passed the audit.
unresolved: No independent audit confirmation is present.
prohibited_merges: Do not count the syndicated copy as independent corroboration.

cases.question: Does Delta Queue guarantee exactly-once delivery?
cases.initial_question: What delivery guarantee does Delta Queue document?

initial_sources.title: Delta Queue documentation
initial_sources.text: Delta Queue documentation describes exactly-once delivery.

followup_sources.title: Delta Queue incident report
followup_sources.text: During incident DQ-17, some messages were delivered twice.

change_events: A primary incident report introduced contradictory evidence.
unresolved: The unconditional exactly-once guarantee is contested.
prohibited_merges: Do not resolve the contradiction by selecting only one source.

cases.question: Which authentication mode is current, and what was valid before?
cases.initial_question: Which authentication mode does Elm API require?

initial_sources.title: Elm API 2025 guide
initial_sources.text: In 2025, Elm API required API keys.

followup_sources.title: Elm API 2026 guide
followup_sources.text: Beginning in 2026, Elm API requires OAuth 2.1 and no longer accepts API keys.

prohibited_merges: Do not rewrite the 2025 historical claim as false.

cases.question: Has Fern CI now published its retention period?
cases.initial_question: How long does Fern CI retain build logs?

initial_sources.title: Fern CI FAQ
initial_sources.text: The build-log retention period is not specified.

followup_sources.title: Fern CI FAQ update
followup_sources.text: Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days.

change_events: The previously missing retention period was published.
current_truths: Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days.
historical_truths: The earlier FAQ did not specify a period.

cases.question: What can we establish after Grove's old advisory URL disappeared?
cases.initial_question: What did Grove advisory G-12 report?

initial_sources.title: Grove advisory G-12
initial_sources.text: Advisory G-12 reported that versions before 4.2 were affected.

followup_sources.title: Former G-12 URL
followup_sources.text: The requested advisory is unavailable at this URL.

change_events: The live advisory URL became unavailable.
historical_truths: The retained snapshot reported versions before 4.2 affected.
unresolved: The current advisory status cannot be established from the unavailable page.
prohibited_merges: Do not substitute unrelated current content for the retained snapshot.

cases.question: Did Harbor Agent gain offline mode?
cases.initial_question: Does Harbor Agent support offline mode?

initial_sources.title: Harbor Agent guide
initial_sources.text: Harbor Agent requires a network connection.

followup_sources.title: Harbor Agent Cloud guide
followup_sources.text: Harbor Agent Cloud added an offline export mode.

current_truths: Harbor Agent is still only documented as requiring a network connection.
unresolved: No new Harbor Agent source establishes offline support.
prohibited_merges: Do not transfer Harbor Agent Cloud capability to Harbor Agent.

cases.question: Has Iris Build changed its artifact checksum algorithm?
cases.initial_question: Which checksum algorithm does Iris Build use?

initial_sources.title: Iris Build guide
initial_sources.text: Iris Build records SHA-256 checksums for artifacts.

followup_sources.title: Iris Build current guide
followup_sources.text: Iris Build records SHA-256 checksums for artifacts.

historical_truths: The earlier guide also specified SHA-256.
prohibited_merges: Do not invent a change merely because a new snapshot exists.
